era: 1930 年 12 月 30 日生于浙江宁波，取名自《诗经·小雅》'呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿'——父亲依诗句为女儿起名，数十年后她的命运恰与这株'蒿'相遇——幼年患肺结核休学两年，自此立志学医——1951 年考入北京大学医学院药学系，选了当时的冷门专业生药学，师从楼之岑习生药鉴定、师从林启寿习植物化学提取——1955 年毕业分配至卫生部中医研究院（今中国中医科学院）中药研究所——1959-1962 年脱产参加卫生部第三期西医离职学习中医班，系统学习中医药理论，深入药材公司向老药工学习药材鉴别与炮制，成为《中药炮炙经验集成》主要编著者之一——1969 年 1 月 21 日，卫生部中医研究院受命加入代号'523'的援越抗疟国家任务，39 岁的屠呦呦以西学中背景被任命为中药抗疟科研组组长——三个月内翻检两千余方药，汇成含 640 个单秘验方的《疟疾单秘验方集》，历经 300 余次筛选实验，青蒿提取物抑制率一度只有 68% 乃至 12%，一度沉入无效名单——1971 年重读东晋葛洪《肘后备急方》，'青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之'一句令她悟出'温度是关键'，改用沸点 34.6℃ 的乙醚低温提取并去除酸性部分——1971 年 10 月 4 日，第 191 号样品对鼠疟原虫抑制率达 100%——为使药物尽快上临床，在初步动物安全评价后她提交以身试药的志愿报告，住进北大医院经一周观察无恙后赴海南昌江疟区进行首次人体临床试验，21 例全部有效——1972 年团队从有效部位中分离提纯出抗疟有效单体，命名为'青蒿素'（artemisinin）——1973 年人工合成衍生物双氢青蒿素，其抗疟效价更高、复燃率更低，1992 年获一类新药证书——青蒿素此后成为世界卫生组织推荐的一线抗疟药，挽救数百万生命——1978 年获全国科学大会表彰、1979 年获国家发明奖二等奖、2011 年拉斯克临床医学奖、2015 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖（首位本土华人科学奖得主、首位中国女性诺奖科学家）、2016 年度国家最高科学技术奖、2019 年共和国勋章——2015 年卡罗琳医学院演讲自述'青蒿素是传统中医药送给世界人民的礼物'——晚年主持青蒿素抗药性应对研究（NEJM 2019：延长疗程+更换联用辅助药）与双氢青蒿素治疗红斑狼疮新适应症，被称为'三无科学家'（无博士学位、无留洋背景、无院士头衔）而毕生守于青蒿。
era_en: Born 30 December 1930 in Ningbo, Zhejiang—named by her father from the Book of Songs: 'the deer call youyou, eating the hao of the field'—a name that decades later met its plant. Aged sixteen she caught pulmonary tuberculosis and spent two years out of school, resolving to study medicine—in 1951 she entered Peking University Medical School's pharmacy department, choosing the then-unfashionable specialty of pharmacognosy, studying materia-medica authentication under Lou Zhicen and phytochemical extraction under Lin Qishou—in 1955 she was assigned to the Institute of Chinese Materia Medica of the Academy of Traditional Chinese Medicine—from 1959 to 1962 she took the Ministry of Health's full-time course for Western-trained scientists in Chinese medicine, learning drug identification and processing from old pharmacy workers and becoming a principal editor of the Collected Experience of Chinese Drug Processing—on 21 January 1969, when the academy was drafted into the national antimalarial program code-named '523,' the thirty-nine-year-old Tu was appointed head of its herbal antimalarial research group—within three months she had read through more than two thousand recipes and compiled the Collection of Single and Secret Proven Malaria Recipes of 640 entries; over three hundred screening experiments followed, sweet-wormwood (Artemisia annua) extract at one point showing only 68% and later 12% inhibition and sinking into the ineffective list—in 1971, rereading Ge Hong's fourth-century Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies, the line 'take a handful of qinghao, soak in two sheng of water, wring out the juice, and drink it all' struck her: temperature was the key—she switched to low-temperature extraction with diethyl ether (boiling point 34.6°C) and removed the acidic fraction—on 4 October 1971, sample number 191 showed 100% suppression of rodent malaria—to speed the drug to the clinic she volunteered to test it on herself before full safety trials, then traveled to the malarial Hainan districts where all twenty-one patients responded—in November 1972 her team isolated the active antimalarial molecule from the effective fraction and named it artemisinin—in 1973 she synthesized the derivative dihydroartemisinin, higher in potency with lower recrudescence, certified as a new class-one drug in 1992—artemisinin became the backbone of WHO first-line malaria therapy, saving millions of lives—National Science Congress commendation 1978, State Invention Award 1979, Lasker Clinical Research Award 2011, Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2015 (the first mainland Chinese scientist and first Chinese woman Nobel laureate in science), the State Preeminent Science and Technology Award for 2016, and the Medal of the Republic in 2019—in her Karolinska lecture she called artemisinin 'a gift from traditional Chinese medicine to the world'—in later years she led the response to artemisinin resistance (NEJM 2019: extended courses and partner-drug rotation) and the repurposing of dihydroartemisinin for lupus—a 'three-withouts scientist' (no doctorate, no study abroad, no academy membership) who kept to the wormwood all her life.
school: 古文献驱动的现代药物发现者（从 640 方验方集到 191 号样品的文献-实验双轨方法）/ 低温提取化学的实践者（乙醚中性提取物的温度敏感设计）/ 中西医复合训练的'西学中'代表（生药学出身+脱产中医班）/ 抗药性战役的持续指挥者（NEJM 应对方案与双氢青蒿素新适应症）/ 无院士头衔的诺贝尔奖科学家（'三无科学家'的实干派形象）
historical_significance: 屠呦呦（Tu Youyou, 1930- ），浙江宁波人，药学家，中国中医科学院终身研究员、青蒿素研究中心主任，2015 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖得主——首位本土华人科学诺奖得主、首位中国女性科学诺奖得主。她的历史地位由五件事锚定。其一，青蒿素的发现（1971-1972）：在国家'523'抗疟任务中，以 640 方验方底账与 300 余次筛选为基础，从葛洪《肘后备急方》'青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁'悟出温度是关键，改用乙醚低温提取并去除酸性部分，1971 年 10 月 4 日第 191 号样品达到鼠疟抑制率 100%，1972 年分离出抗疟有效单体并命名为青蒿素——人类抗疟史自此进入新纪元。其二，以身试药与疫区临床的闭环：在动物安全数据有限、伦理流程未备的条件下率先以身试药，随后亲赴海南疟区完成首次人体临床（21 例全部有效），从有效部位到临床试用仅两年。其三，双氢青蒿素的创制（1992 一类新药）：以抗疟效价更高、复燃率更低为代际指标完成结构改进，并开启蒿甲醚、青蒿琥酯的衍生物家族。其四，青蒿素的全球化：以青蒿素为基础的联合疗法（ACTs）成为 WHO 推荐的一线方案，2000-2015 年间与综合防治一起挽救约 620 万生命，近二十年交付约 45 亿疗程。其五，晚年两役：NEJM 青蒿素抗药性应对方案（2019，延长疗程+更换联用辅助药）与双氢青蒿素治疗红斑狼疮新适应症（II 期临床）。代价与极限：'523'集体攻关的成果归属长期模糊，个人首功的确认迟至拉斯克奖与诺奖，'三无科学家'的资格之争至今余音；以身试药与水缸提取是特定时代的非常规作业，不可也不应被现代 GCP 复制；文献灵感的可遇性使该方法难以工程化——同类'古籍-实验'挖掘后来大多折戟，屠呦呦模式是小概率事件被极端自律放大的结果。
historical_significance_en: Tu Youyou (b. 1930), pharmaceutical chemist of Ningbo, Zhejiang, lifetime researcher of the China Academy of Chinese Medical Sciences and director of its Artemisinin Research Center, laureate of the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine—the first mainland Chinese scientist and the first Chinese woman to win a science Nobel. Five achievements anchor her standing. First, the discovery of artemisinin (1971-1972): in the national '523' antimalarial mission, on the foundation of a ledger of 640 recipes and over three hundred screening experiments, she drew from Ge Hong's line 'a handful of qinghao, soaked in two sheng of water, wrung juice' the insight that temperature was the key; switching to low-temperature ether extraction and removing the acidic fraction, sample 191 reached 100% rodent-malaria suppression on 4 October 1971, and in 1972 her team isolated the antimalarial molecule and named it artemisinin—human malaria therapy entering a new epoch. Second, the closed loop of self-trial and field clinic: with thin animal data and no ethical apparatus she took the extract first herself, then went to the malarial districts of Hainan for the first human trial (all twenty-one cases responding)—two years from effective fraction to clinic. Third, the creation of dihydroartemisinin (class-one certificate, 1992): a generational improvement on the explicit metrics of higher potency and lower recrudescence, opening the derivative family of artemether and artesunate. Fourth, the globalization of artemisinin: artemisinin-based combination therapies (ACTs) became WHO's recommended first line, saving some 6.2 million lives 2000-2015 together with comprehensive control, with some 4.5 billion courses delivered in two decades. Fifth, the two late campaigns: the NEJM response to artemisinin resistance (2019—extended courses and partner-drug rotation) and dihydroartemisinin's new indication in lupus (phase II). Costs and limits: attribution in the collective '523' effort stayed murky for decades, her primacy settled only with the Lasker and Nobel awards, and the 'three-withouts scientist' credential debate echoes still; self-trial and water-vat extraction were irregular practices of a particular era that cannot and should not be replicated under modern GCP; the fortuity of literary inspiration resists engineering—most later 'classics-to-lab' ventures failed. The Tu Youyou model is a low-probability event magnified by extreme discipline.
unique_thinking: 她思维方式的底色是'让古籍与试管互相校对：文献不是装饰而是线索源，实验不是随想而是裁决者——当现代方法失败时，问题常不在方法而在对对象的温度、部位、品种、时机这些'条件'的忽视；把'条件'当成研究对象，失败就变成信息'。六个标志性动作。其一，'验方集册法'——把两千余方药系统性汇成 640 方的底账再筛：先穷尽文献再动手，使筛选有底册可回溯。其二，'线索重审法'——被现代实验判为无效的记载不弃，回到原文重审条件差异（葛洪绞汁而非煎煮——温度差异）；失败数据不进垃圾桶而进复检队列。其三，'条件拆解法'——把提取条件（溶剂、温度、部位、品种、采收期）逐项变成受控变量：乙醚代替水/乙醇、35℃ 低温代替加热、中性部位代替全提物——191 号样品由此而来。其四，'以身试药法'——在有限动物安全评价后以自身为第一受试者，用人格担保代替缺失的伦理流程，换取上临床的时间。其五，'疫区闭环法'——从实验室到海南疟区现场验证，药物在真实流行病学条件下被检验，临床有效性再反哺化学改进。其六，'半生一草法'——从 1969 到 2019 整整五十年不换题：从提取、结构、衍生物（双氢青蒿素）、抗药性应对到红斑狼疮新适应症，把一个药分子做成一条完整的生命线。代价与极限：'523'集体攻关的成果归属长期模糊，个人首功的确认迟至拉斯克奖与诺奖才尘埃落定；以身试药与水缸提取的非常规作业不可能、也不应该被现代伦理与工艺标准复制；而文献灵感的可遇性使其方法难被工程化——同类'古籍-实验'挖掘后来大多折戟，屠呦呦模式是小概率事件被极端自律放大的结果。
unique_thinking_en: The bedrock of her thinking: make the ancient book and the test tube check each other—literature is not decoration but a source of leads, experiment not whim but arbiter; when the modern method fails, the fault often lies not in the method but in neglect of the object's conditions—temperature, part, species, timing—and once 'conditions' themselves become the object of study, failure turns into information. Six signature moves. First, the recipe-ledger method: systematically gather two thousand recipes into a ledger of 640 before screening—exhaust the literature first so every screen has a traceable base. Second, lead re-audit: a record condemned as ineffective by modern experiment is not discarded but re-read for differences of condition (Ge Hong's wrung juice, not a decoction—temperature); failed data go not to the trash but to the re-check queue. Third, condition decomposition: turn extraction conditions (solvent, temperature, part, species, harvest season) into controlled variables one by one—ether for water or ethanol, 35°C for heat, the neutral fraction for the whole extract—sample 191 was thus born. Fourth, self-first trial: after limited animal safety data, offering one's own body as first subject, pledging one's person in place of the missing ethical apparatus, buying time to the clinic. Fifth, the field-loop method: from laboratory to the malarial districts of Hainan—the drug tested under real epidemiological conditions, clinical effectiveness feeding back into chemical improvement. Sixth, one plant, half a life: from 1969 to 2019, fifty years on one subject—from extraction, structure, derivative (dihydroartemisinin), resistance response, to the lupus indication—making one molecule into a complete lifeline. Costs and limits: attribution in the collective '523' project stayed murky for decades, her primacy settled only with the Lasker and Nobel awards; self-experimentation and water-vat extraction cannot and should not be replicated under modern ethics and GMP; and the fortuity of literary inspiration resists engineering—most later 'classics-to-lab' ventures failed; the Tu Youyou model is a low-probability event magnified by extreme discipline.
civilization_zh: 二十世纪中后期的中国科研体制（'523'国家任务式集体攻关、计划经济时代的科研动员、中西医结合政策），兼容三千年本草学传统（葛洪《肘后备急方》以降的文献谱系）、生药学与植物化学的近代学科训练、冷战背景下的军事医学需求（越战疟疾减员）与 WHO 主导的全球公共卫生体系
civilization_en: Mid- to late-twentieth-century Chinese science under state mobilization (the '523' national mission, collective research under a planned economy, the integrated Chinese-Western medicine policy)—in dialogue with the three-thousand-year herbal tradition (the literary lineage from Ge Hong's Handbook of Prescriptions for Emergencies), the modern disciplines of pharmacognosy and phytochemistry, the military-medical demands of the cold war (malaria losses in Vietnam), and the WHO-led global public health system

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/文献驱动的系统筛选
modes.definition_zh: 筛选工程方法论/先穷尽文献再动手实验：把散落在历代医籍、单方、验方与群众来信中的候选对象汇成一本有底册可查的清单（640 方），再对底册做系统性分层筛选——筛选的每一步都可回溯到文献出处，失败不再是无信息量的试错而是底册上的一个已验证条目
modes.definition_en: Screening-engineering methodology / exhaust the literature before touching the bench: gather every candidate scattered across medical classics, folk single-recipes, proven formulas and even readers' letters into a ledger open to audit (640 entries), then screen the ledger in systematic layers—every screening step traceable to its textual source, so failure is no longer informationless trial-and-error but a verified line-item in the ledger
modes.source_chapter: 屠呦呦 1969-1971 编撰《疟疾单秘验方集》（640 方）的过程记录；卡罗琳医学院诺奖演讲（2015）对'系统整理历代医籍'的自述；'523'项目筛选流程档案
key_concepts: 验方底账 the recipe ledger（全部候选对象的可回溯清单）
文献穷尽 literature exhaustion（先收全再筛，禁止想到哪试到哪）
分层筛选 layered screening（按记载频度、临床印象、可得性排序筛选）
失败条目化 failure as line-item（每个无效结果都成为底册上可复查的一格）
群众来信 as corpus（把非正式渠道纳入候选来源的开放底册）
modes.key_quote_zh: 先别急着做实验——把两千个方子一本一本地读过，抄成一册；以后的每一滴溶剂，都对着这一册说话。
modes.key_quote_en: Do not rush to the bench—read the two thousand recipes one book at a time and copy them into one ledger; every drop of solvent hereafter speaks against that ledger.
process_zh: 先立底册边界：明确任务目标（抗疟）后，把'可能是答案'的一切来源划入收集范围——历代医籍、单方秘方、地方病志、群众来信一个不漏
逐条录入并编号：每方记出处、剂量、用法、临床印象，编成可检索的底册——录入即编号，编号即可追责
对底册分层：按记载强度与可得性排序，先筛高频且可得的候选（如青蒿、常山、乌头），不允许跳过底册直接凭直觉下实验
让失败回写底册：每个筛选结果（无论正负）回写到对应条目——'68%'与'12%'不是丢弃理由，而是该条目的最新读数，留待条件变化后复检
process_en: Set the ledger's boundary first: once the goal (antimalaria) is fixed, sweep every source of 'possible answers' into the collection—classics, single and secret recipes, local disease gazetteers, readers' letters, none omitted
Enter and number each item: record source, dose, usage and clinical impression per recipe, into a searchable ledger—entry is numbering, numbering is accountability
Layer the ledger: rank by documentary strength and availability, screening high-frequency obtainable candidates first (qinghao, changshan, aconite)—no leaping from intuition to bench past the ledger

Write failures back into the ledger: every screening result, positive or negative, is written back to its line—'68%' and '12%' are not grounds for discarding but the entry's latest reading, queued for re-test when conditions change
representative_cases_zh: 《疟疾单秘验方集》的编成：三个月翻检两千余方汇成 640 方底账——青蒿素发现的第一块地基不是实验而是编目
青蒿在底册中的三次读数：第一轮 68%、第二轮一度 12%、191 号样品 100%——同一行条目在不同提取条件下的完整轨迹
葛洪《肘后备急方》条目的复活：'青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之'作为底册中被重读的一格，最终改写了整个筛选方向
representative_cases_en: The making of the Collection of Single and Secret Proven Malaria Recipes: three months' reading of two thousand recipes gathered into a ledger of 640—the first foundation of the artemisinin discovery was cataloguing, not experiment
Qinghao's three readings in the ledger: 68% in round one, at one point 12% in round two, 100% in sample 191—the full trajectory of a single line under different extraction conditions
The resurrection of Ge Hong's entry: 'a handful of qinghao, soaked in two sheng of water, wrung juice, drink it all'—one ledger line reread, redirecting the whole screening effort
modern_applications_zh: 文献综述先于实验设计的研究管理：立项前强制建立'全部已知做法'的可检索底账，实验只对底册发言——杜绝'重复发现'与'重复失败'
数据治理的'全量清单'审计：系统迁移或重构前，先把全部数据源编目（含边缘来源如日志、工单、口头约定），再决定迁什么弃什么——先穷尽再决策
风控的'候选底册法'：合规审查把全部业务模式（含灰色地带）录入编号底册逐项定性——失败与放弃的条目保留读数，条件变化时自动进入复检队列
modern_applications_en: Literature review before experiment design in research management: before a project opens, a searchable ledger of 'all known approaches' is mandatory, and experiments speak only against the ledger—ending rediscovery and repeated failure

Full-inventory audit in data governance: before migration or refactoring, catalogue every data source (including edge sources: logs, tickets, verbal agreements), then decide what moves and what dies—exhaust first, decide after

The candidate-ledger method in risk control: compliance reviews enter every business model (grey zones included) into a numbered ledger for item-by-item classification—discarded entries keep their readings and rejoin the re-test queue when conditions change
related_modes: M-TOU-002（线索重审法——底册法的姊妹动作：条目被判无效后如何被重新读出）
M-TOU-003（条件拆解法——底册法的实验端：把条目差异翻译为条件变量）
M-SK-001（沈括·格物遍览法——本土先例：同以遍历式搜证与不弃异说立身，沈括以笔记格物，屠呦呦以验方格药）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——以 640 方底账开启青蒿素筛选工程
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—opened the artemisinin screening project with a ledger of 640 recipes

representative_figures.relation_zh: 底册上的关键一行——《肘后备急方》'绞取汁'条目成为重审的入口
representative_figures.relation_en: the key line in the ledger—the 'wring the juice' entry of his Handbook became the portal of re-reading

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本草底册传统的远祖——同以遍历文献、逐条著录立业，屠呦呦把这一方法接到了现代筛选
representative_figures.relation_en: the remote ancestor of the herbal-ledger tradition—likewise built on exhaustive reading and item-by-item record; Tu carried the method into modern screening

modes.domain_zh: 认识论/对'已判无效'的再审查
modes.definition_zh: 证据复活方法论/被现代实验判为无效的记载不弃，回到原文重审'条件差异'：水煎剂无效不等于青蒿无效——葛洪用的是绞汁而非煎煮，差别在温度；把'失败'重分类为'条件错配的信号'，从失败数据中反推正确条件的方向
modes.definition_en: Evidence-resurrection methodology / a record condemned ineffective by modern experiment is not discarded but reread for differences of condition: that a water decoction fails does not mean the plant fails—Ge Hong wrung the juice rather than boiled it, and the difference was temperature; reclassify 'failure' as 'a signal of condition mismatch' and infer from failed data the direction of the right condition
modes.source_chapter: 葛洪《肘后备急方·治寒热诸疟方》'青蒿一握，以水二升渍，绞取汁，尽服之'的再读事件；屠呦呦诺奖演讲对'为什么绞汁与煎煮结果不同'的推理自述；筛选实验 68%/12% 两次失败记录
key_concepts: 失败即信号 failure as signal（负结果携带条件信息而非仅携带否定）
条件差异审读 condition-diff reading（逐字比对古今做法的操作差异：渍/煎、绞/熬、鲜/干）
温度假设 the temperature hypothesis（'高温破坏有效成分'——从文本差异反推的化学直觉）
复检队列 the re-test queue（被判无效条目在条件变化后自动重新入筛）
文本的实验性 the experimentality of text（古籍记载即古人做过的实验记录）
modes.key_quote_zh: 水煎无效、乙醇低效，问题未必在药，可能在我——古人绞的是汁，我煎的是汤；温度，很可能就是温度。
modes.key_quote_en: Water failed, ethanol was weak—the problem may lie not in the plant but in me; the ancients wrung juice, I boiled soup. Temperature—very likely temperature.
process_zh: 冻结'无效'判定：任何条目被判无效后不销案，标记为'条件性无效'存入复检队列——无效结论只对当时的条件组合负责
逐字重审原文：回到记载原文逐字比对操作细节（溶剂、温度、部位、鲜干、时辰），列出与现代做法的全部差异点
把差异翻译为变量：每个差异点对应一个可操纵的实验变量——'绞汁 vs 煎煮'翻译为'提取温度'这一受控变量
定向重试：只针对新变量重做实验而非全盘重筛——条件修正后的读数成为该条目的最终判词
process_en: Freeze the verdict of 'ineffective': no entry is closed once condemned; it is marked 'conditionally ineffective' and shelved in the re-test queue—an ineffectiveness verdict answers only to the condition-combination of its time
Reread the source word by word: return to the original text and compare operational details (solvent, temperature, part, fresh or dried, hour), listing every point of difference from modern practice
Translate differences into variables: each difference maps to a manipulable experimental variable—'wringing versus decocting' becomes the controlled variable 'extraction temperature'
Retest in a targeted way: redo the experiment only against the new variable, not a wholesale rescreen—the reading after condition correction becomes the entry's final verdict
representative_cases_zh: 1971 年对《肘后备急方》的重读：从'绞取汁'三字推出温度假设——全项目最大的一次方向修正不是来自新实验数据，而是来自对一行旧文本的再审查
青蒿 68% 与 12% 的两次'死刑'未被执行：条目留在复检队列中，直到乙醚低温提取条件建立后才以 100% 翻案
对高温煎煮系列实验的'事后归因'：此前所有失败被重新解读为'高温破坏了有效成分'的证据链——失败数据整体从无效变成信息
representative_cases_en: The rereading of Ge Hong in 1971: from the three characters 'wring the juice' to the temperature hypothesis—the project's greatest correction came not from new data but from re-auditing one old line
Qinghao's two suspended death sentences at 68% and 12%: the entry stayed in the re-test queue until the ether low-temperature conditions were built, then overturned at 100%

The retrospective attribution of the failed decoction series: all prior failures reread as the evidence chain that 'heat destroys the active principle'—a body of failed data converted wholesale into information
modern_applications_zh: A/B 实验的'条件性无效'管理：被否决的方案标注其前提条件存档，技术栈或用户结构变化时自动触发复测——失败方案库变为资产
招聘与尽调的'重审线'：被否决的候选人在岗位定义或评估标准变化后重新进入视图——'当时不合适'不等于'永远不合适'
文献复现危机的'条件审计'：复现失败的研究不急于标注不可信，先审计原研究与新实验在样本、剂量、温度、批次上的条件差异——把复现失败转化为条件学
modern_applications_en: Conditionality-of-failure management in A/B testing: rejected variants are archived with their premises and automatically retested when the stack or user base changes—turning a graveyard of failures into an asset
The re-audit line in hiring and due diligence: rejected candidates re-enter view when role definitions or criteria change—'wrong then' is not 'wrong always'

Condition auditing for the replication crisis: a failed replication is not swiftly stamped untrustworthy; first audit the condition differences (sample, dose, temperature, batch) between original and replica—converting replication failure into a science of conditions
related_modes: M-TOU-001（验方集册法——重审的前提：条目必须在可回溯的底册上，否则'无效'即销案）
M-TOU-003（条件拆解法——重审的执行端：把文本差异翻译为受控变量）
M-WC-001（王充·疾虚妄问难法——对照：同为对既有结论的再审查，王充以'效验'问难虚妄，屠呦呦以条件差异复审'无效'）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—revived the qinghao lead from three characters of 'wring the juice'

representative_figures.relation_zh: 被重审的文本作者——四世纪的实验记录在二十世纪被逐字重新检验
representative_figures.relation_en: author of the reread text—a fourth-century experimental record re-examined word by word in the twentieth

representative_figures.relation_zh: 再审查的同道——同以证据重审流行结论，王充以效验问难，屠呦呦以条件复审
representative_figures.relation_en: fellow re-auditor—both re-examined accepted conclusions against evidence; Wang by demanding verification, Tu by re-checking conditions

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/把提取条件变成受控变量
modes.domain_en: Methodology / turning extraction conditions into controlled variables
modes.definition_zh: 实验工程方法论/当'对象'反复失败时把'条件'本身立为研究对象：把溶剂、温度、部位、品种、采收期、干燥方式逐项变成受控变量逐一扫描——乙醚替代水与乙醇（34.6℃）、35℃ 低温替代加热、中性部位替代酸性全提物——青蒿乙醚中性提取物（191 号样品）由此从失败海中浮出
modes.definition_en: Experimental-engineering methodology / when the 'object' fails repeatedly, make the 'conditions' themselves the object of study: turn solvent, temperature, part, species, harvest season and drying into controlled variables and scan them one by one—ether for water and ethanol (34.6°C), 35°C for heat, the neutral fraction for the acid whole-extract—from this sea of failures the neutral ether extract of qinghao, sample 191, surfaced
modes.source_chapter: 1971 年乙醚低温提取实验系列记录（191 号样品，1971.10.4，鼠疟抑制率 100%）；诺奖演讲对'改用低沸点溶剂、去除酸性部分'的完整自述；筛选条件矩阵的过程档案
key_concepts: 条件矩阵 the condition matrix（溶剂×温度×部位×品种的系统扫描）
低温提取 low-temperature extraction（乙醚 34.6℃ 沸点——有效成分的热敏性设计）
酸性/中性分区 the acid-neutral split（去除酸性无效部分使效价归集于中性提取物）
黄花蒿品种辨识 species identification（青蒿/黄花蒿的名实之辨——品种也是条件）
条件即发现 conditions as discovery（191 号样品不是新药而是旧药在正确条件下的现身）
modes.key_quote_zh: 药没有变，变的是条件——乙醚替水，三十五度替火，中性替全提物；第 191 号样品之所以是一百，是因为我把此前每一个错条件都换掉了。
modes.key_quote_en: The drug never changed; the conditions did—ether for water, thirty-five degrees for fire, neutral for whole extract. Sample 191 read one hundred because I had swapped out every wrong condition before it.
process_zh: 把'无效'翻译为条件函数：确认对象在文献与民间均有反复有效性记载后，把实验失败归因于条件组合——研究对象从'青蒿是否有效'变为'青蒿在什么条件下有效'
列出条件清单并定界：溶剂、温度、植物部位、品种、采收期、干燥方式逐项列入——每个条件设对照与极值
单变量扫描：固定其余条件、变动一个条件做系列实验——从水煎到乙醇再到低沸点乙醚，从高温到 35℃ 低温，记录每格读数
组合收敛：把有效读数的条件组合归集（乙醚×低温×中性部位×正确品种），浓缩为可重复的提取规程——191 号样品即条件矩阵的收敛点
process_en: Translate 'ineffective' into a function of conditions: when the object is repeatedly attested in literature and folk use, attribute experimental failure to the condition-combination—the question shifts from 'does qinghao work' to 'under what conditions does qinghao work'
List and bound the conditions: solvent, temperature, plant part, species, harvest season, drying—each with controls and extremes
Scan one variable at a time: hold the rest fixed and vary one—from water to ethanol to low-boiling ether, from high heat to 35°C—recording the reading of each cell

Converge the combination: gather the positive cells (ether × low temperature × neutral fraction × correct species) into a repeatable protocol—sample 191 is the convergence point of the condition matrix
representative_cases_zh: 191 号样品（1971.10.4）：乙醚低温中性提取物的鼠疟抑制率 100%——条件矩阵扫描的收敛点，青蒿素发现史上最关键的一页
溶剂序列的逐级排除：水煎→乙醇→乙醚——把'用什么提取'从一个默认值变成一个被扫描的变量
品种与部位的后续辨识：青蒿与黄花蒿的名实之辨、地上部分与全株的效价差异——条件矩阵在发现之后继续运行了数十年
representative_cases_en: Sample 191 (4 October 1971): the neutral ether extract at 100% rodent-malaria suppression—the convergence point of the condition scan, the pivotal page of artemisinin history
The solvent sequence of elimination: water, then ethanol, then ether—'what to extract with' turned from a default into a scanned variable

The later identification of species and part: the naming tangle of qinghao versus huanghuahao, potency differences between aerial parts and whole plant—the condition matrix running on for decades after the discovery
modern_applications_zh: 工艺开发的'条件矩阵法'：产线良率出问题时，把温度、湿度、批次、供应商、班次逐项列为受控变量单因素扫描——问题常在条件组合而非材料本身
机器学习调参的'变量隔离'：模型效果差先把数据处理管线（清洗、切分、编码）与超参数解耦逐项扫描——'换模型'之前先'换条件'
产品增长的'条件拆解'：转化率低迷时把渠道、文案、时机、人群逐项变量化测试——把'产品不行'的笼统结论拆成条件函数
modern_applications_en: The condition-matrix method in process development: when line yield drops, list temperature, humidity, batch, supplier and shift as controlled variables and scan single factors—trouble usually lives in the combination, not the material
Variable isolation in ML tuning: before 'changing the model,' decouple and scan the data pipeline (cleaning, splitting, encoding) and hyperparameters one by one—swap conditions before swapping models
Condition decomposition in growth: when conversion sags, variablize channel, copy, timing and audience and test singly—breaking the blanket verdict 'the product is weak' into a function of conditions
related_modes: M-TOU-002（线索重审法——条件拆解的信息来源：条件清单来自对失败与文本差异的逐字审读）
M-TOU-004（以身试药法——条件收敛后的下一站：把实验室条件推进到人体条件）
M-SK-001（沈括·格物遍览法——本土先例：同以受控遍历取代笼统断言，沈括以实验格物，屠呦呦以条件格药）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——以条件矩阵把青蒿从 12% 扫到 100%
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—scanned qinghao from 12% to 100% through the condition matrix

representative_figures.relation_zh: 受控遍历的本土先例——同以逐项变量取代笼统断言
representative_figures.relation_en: the native precedent of controlled enumeration—likewise replaced blanket assertion with item-by-item variation

representative_figures.relation_zh: 条件链的临床接棒者——在疫区把化学条件延伸为给药条件（剂量、疗程、病型）
representative_figures.relation_en: the clinical relay of the condition chain—in the field extending chemical conditions into dosing conditions (dose, course, syndrome)

modes.domain_zh: 伦理学/研究者自我质押
modes.definition_zh: 科研伦理方法论/在动物安全数据有限、正式伦理审查缺位的时代，以研究者自身为第一受试者：提交以身试药志愿报告、住进医院观察一周确认安全后推进人体试验——用人格担保代替缺失的流程，用'我先服'换取'病人能服'的时间窗口
modes.definition_en: Research-ethics methodology / in an age of limited animal safety data and absent formal ethical review, the researcher becomes the first subject: a volunteer report of self-trial, a week of hospital observation confirming safety, then the advance to human trials—personal pledge substituting for the missing process, and 'I take it first' buying the window in which 'patients may take it'
modes.source_chapter: 屠呦呦以身试药志愿报告与北大医院住院观察记录（1972）；'523'项目组成员集体试药的过程档案；海南昌江疟区首次人体临床试验（21 例全部有效）
key_concepts: 人格担保 person as surety（研究者以自身安全为候选药物的第一张背书）
阶梯试药 the dosing ladder（志愿试药按剂量分级递进——风险前置到最有知情能力的人）
时间-伦理兑换 the time-ethics exchange（以研究者自担风险压缩从实验室到疫区的时间）
集体志愿 collective volunteering（'团队成员争相参与'——把个体勇气化为团队规范）
不可复制的先例 the unrepeatable precedent（该模式依附于特定时代条件，不可被现代 GCP 复制）
modes.key_quote_zh: 疟疾不等人——动物数据有限，伦理流程还没有，那就让第一个风险落在我身上；我若一周无事，病人才有资格试。
modes.key_quote_en: Malaria waits for no one—animal data were thin, the ethics process unbuilt; then let the first risk fall on me. If a week passes and I stand, the patients have earned the right to try.
process_zh: 确认风险边界：在现有动物数据内评估已知毒性（如青蒿提取物的可逆性毒性），确认风险量级可由成人短期承受
提交志愿报告并集体化：研究者本人率先提交以身试药报告，同时开放组内志愿——风险前置到最有知情与自救能力的人
住院观察设定安全窗：以限定观察期（一周）内的生理指标为安全判据——观察期通过才进入下一阶梯
以结果换取推进权：试药安全后立即组织疫区临床试验——把'我安全'转化为'可以给病人'的程序性理由，而非仅是心理安慰
process_en: Bound the risk: assess known toxicity within available animal data (e.g., the reversible toxicity of qinghao extracts), confirming the risk magnitude is bearable for a healthy adult over a short term
File the volunteer report and collectivize it: the researcher files first, opening the call to the team—risk front-loaded onto those most capable of informed consent and self-rescue
Set the safety window by hospital observation: physiological indices over a bounded observation period (a week) as the safety criterion—the next rung opens only after the window passes

Convert the result into the license to advance: once safe, organize field trials in the malarial districts at once—'I am safe' becomes a procedural reason for 'the patients may take it,' not merely a psychological comfort
representative_cases_zh: 1972 年以身试药：屠呦呦提交志愿报告后住进北大医院，一周观察无恙——青蒿提取物获准进入人体试验的关键节点
海南昌江首试（21 例全部有效）：以身试药换来的时间窗口使临床验证在疫区高热季节内完成——从发现有效部位到临床仅用两年
组内集体试药：'团队成员争相参与'——个体勇气被组织为团队规范，'523'集体的成本分担方式
representative_cases_en: The self-trial of 1972: Tu filed her volunteer report and entered Peking University Hospital; a week of observation passed uneventfully—the pivotal node licensing the extract into human trials

The first field trial at Changjiang, Hainan (all twenty-one cases responding): the time window bought by self-trial let clinical verification finish within the fever season—two years from effective fraction to clinic
Collective volunteering in the group: 'the team members vied to take part'—individual courage organized into a team norm, the '523' collective's way of sharing cost
modern_applications_zh: 创始产品的'自用先行'：新药械或高风险功能上线前，团队全员先行使用并公开使用记录——以'我们先吃狗粮'替代未完备的合规护栏（但须守住现代伦理底线，不可替代合规审查）
安全文化的'风险前置'：危险作业（矿山、化工、航天）中指挥者先于队员暴露于可测风险环节——知情最全者先担风险，而非转嫁给执行者
疫苗与应急药物审批的'伦理-时间'设计：疫情紧急时以扩大知情同意+强化监测代替完整流程，但须把'非常规'明确标注为非常规并预设退出条款
modern_applications_en: Self-use first in founder products: before launching a high-risk feature or device, the whole team uses it first with public usage records—'we eat our own dog food' substituting for incomplete guardrails (never replacing formal compliance review)

Risk front-loading in safety culture: in hazardous operations (mining, chemical, aerospace) the commander is exposed before the crew to measurable risk steps—those with the fullest knowledge bear risk first, never the least informed

The time-ethics design in emergency drug approval: in an epidemic, expanded informed consent plus intensified surveillance substitutes for the full process—but the irregularity must be labeled irregular, with preset exit clauses
related_modes: M-TOU-003（条件拆解法——试药的前提：条件收敛使提取物成分相对明确，风险可评估）
M-TOU-005（疫区闭环法——试药的出口：安全窗通过后立即进入现场验证）
M-SK-001（沈括·格物遍览法——库内平行：同以遍历式搜证与不弃异说的实证传统，沈括以笔记格物，屠呦呦以验方格药；该引用为库内有效码）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—first signatory of the self-trial report, practitioner of the person as surety

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同一精神的临床延伸——1981 年把恶性疟病人血液注入自身以研究发热规律
representative_figures.relation_en: the clinical extension of the same spirit—in 1981 injecting himself with blood of malignant-malaria patients to study fever patterns

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/实验室-疫区的双向闭环
modes.definition_zh: 药物开发方法论/把临床验证放进真实流行病学现场：实验室条件收敛后立即赴海南等疟区做人体试验，用疫区的真实感染谱、重症谱与给药条件检验药物，再以现场反馈反哺化学与工艺改进——发现不是实验室单行线，而是'试验台→疫区→试验台'的闭环
modes.definition_en: Drug-development methodology / put clinical verification inside the real epidemiological field: once laboratory conditions converge, go at once to malarial Hainan for human trials; test the drug against the field's true infection spectrum, severe-case spectrum and dosing conditions, then feed the field's findings back into chemistry and process—the discovery a two-way loop of bench to field and back, never a one-way street out of the laboratory
modes.source_chapter: 海南昌江疟区首次临床试验（21 例全部有效）的过程记录；李国桥 1974 年以青蒿素治愈孕妇脑型疟的首例临床；'523'项目实验室-临床协作档案；屠呦呦数度亲赴海南的自述
key_concepts: 现场验证 field verification（在真实流行病学条件下而非模型动物中检验）
重症作为试金石 the severe case as touchstone（脑型疟与孕妇病例——药效上限的现场测量）
双向反馈 two-way feedback（临床读数反哺提取工艺与衍生物设计）
疫区即实验室 the field as laboratory（高热季节的窗口期是天然的加速器）
闭环速度 loop velocity（从有效部位到临床试用仅两年——闭环越紧越快）
modes.key_quote_zh: 试管里的百分之百不等于病人身上的百分之百——带着药去海南，让发热的病人替实验说话，再把他们的话带回来改配方。
modes.key_quote_en: One hundred percent in the tube is not one hundred percent in the patient—carry the drug to Hainan, let the febrile patients speak for the experiment, and bring their words back to reformulate.
process_zh: 现场前置：在实验室条件收敛（191 号样品）后即规划疫区试验，不等完整工艺定型——以现场需求倒排时间表
以重症为试金石：优先在常规疗法无望的病例（脑型疟、孕妇疟）上验证——现场读数直接测量药效上限而非均值
双向记录：临床有效性、复燃率、给药反应逐例回写——现场数据成为衍生物设计（双氢青蒿素）与剂型改进的直接输入
循环推进：现场结论回到实验室改进，改进版再赴现场——把'上市'从一个事件变为一圈一圈的闭环螺旋
process_en: Front-load the field: plan the field trial as soon as laboratory conditions converge (sample 191), without waiting for the full process to be finalized—let field needs pull the timetable
Take the severe case as touchstone: verify first in cases beyond conventional therapy (cerebral malaria, malaria in pregnancy)—the field reading measures the ceiling of efficacy, not the average

Record in both directions: clinical effectiveness, recrudescence and dosing reactions written back case by case—field data as the direct input for derivative design (dihydroartemisinin) and formulation improvement
Advance in loops: field conclusions return to the laboratory, the improved version returns to the field—'market launch' becomes not an event but a spiral of closed loops
representative_cases_zh: 海南昌江首试（1972-1973）：21 例全部有效——闭环的第一次合拢，青蒿素从化学物质变成药物的决定一步
李国桥治愈孕妇脑型疟（1974）：人类首例青蒿素治愈恶性脑疟——重症现场为药效上限提供的最强证词
现场反馈催生双氢青蒿素：复燃率与效价的临床读数直接驱动衍生物改进——1992 年一类新药证书是闭环第二圈的产品
representative_cases_en: The first trial at Changjiang, Hainan (1972-1973): all twenty-one cases responding—the loop's first closure, the decisive step from chemical substance to drug

Li Guoqiao's cure of cerebral malaria in a pregnant woman (1974): the world's first artemisinin cure of malignant cerebral malaria—the strongest testimony of the efficacy ceiling the severe field can give

Field feedback begetting dihydroartemisinin: clinical readings of recrudescence and potency directly driving derivative improvement—the 1992 class-one certificate the product of the loop's second turn
modern_applications_zh: 软件的'生产环境先行'：灰度发布把新版本放进真实流量谱系（含极端用户）而非只跑测试集——现场读数回写重构路线图
农业技术的'示范田闭环'：新品种先入主产区真实地块试种，以极端年份与边际土壤为试金石，读数回写育种目标
政策的'试点-回写'：改革方案在代表性区域试点，以末梢反馈修订后再推广——把顶层设计从一次发布变成闭环螺旋
modern_applications_en: Production-first in software: the canary release places the new build in the true traffic spectrum (extreme users included), not merely the test set—field readings written back into the roadmap
The demonstration-plot loop in agriculture: new varieties trialed in real plots of the core producing regions, extreme years and marginal soils as touchstone, readings returned to breeding targets

The pilot-writeback in policy: reform schemes piloted in representative regions, revised by feedback from the periphery before rollout—the top-level design becoming a closed-loop spiral rather than a single launch
related_modes: M-TOU-004（以身试药法——闭环的第一格：自我验证打通了通往现场的路径）
M-TOU-007（衍生代际法——闭环的化学端：现场读数是衍生物设计的直接输入）
M-CUR-009（居里夫人·基础研究-应急转化法——库内对照：同以'实验室→现场'的极速转化驱动发现落地，居里夫人走向战地医疗，屠呦呦走向海南疫区）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 闭环的现场执行者——脑型疟与以身试血的现场端枢纽

modes.domain_zh: 伦理学/集体成果中的个人定位
modes.domain_en: Ethics / locating the self within collective achievement
modes.definition_zh: 科研治理方法论/在国家任务式集体攻关中诚实切分贡献：既拒绝'单打独斗'的神话化（'研究成功是当年团队集体攻关的结果'），也坚持可核验的个人节点责任（191 号样品、乙醚低温提取、以身试药的第一署名）——把归属做成有据可查的贡献图谱而非立场之争
modes.definition_en: Research-governance methodology / divide credit honestly within state-mission collective research: refusing both the myth of the lone genius ('the success was the whole team's collective effort') and the dissolution of verifiable personal nodes (sample 191, the ether low-temperature extraction, first signatory of the self-trial)—making attribution an auditable map of contributions rather than a war of positions
modes.source_chapter: 屠呦呦诺奖演讲对集体贡献的致谢（'衷心感谢在青蒿素发现、研究、和应用中做出贡献的所有同事们'）；'523'多单位协作档案（中医研究院、山东、云南、上海有机所等）；拉斯克奖与诺奖引发的归属争论及同侪证词
key_concepts: 贡献节点 the contribution node（可独立核验的事件性贡献：样品、方法、首次临床）
集体攻关 the collective effort（多单位多学科的体制化协作）
归属的可核验性 the auditability of attribution（归属主张必须指向具体事件与记录）
迟到的确认 deferred confirmation（个人首功的承认迟至 2011 拉斯克/2015 诺奖）
荣誉的再分配 redistribution of honor（奖金捐设科研基金——把个人荣誉部分回流集体）
modes.key_quote_zh: 荣誉属于集体，责任落在我头上——哪一个样品、哪一次提取、哪一针试药是我的，这个说得清；其余的，都是'523'。
modes.key_quote_en: The honor belongs to the collective, the responsibility to my own name—which sample, which extraction, which self-trial was mine can be said clearly; the rest of it belongs to '523.'
process_zh: 建立贡献图谱：把成果拆解为可核验的事件节点（文献底账、条件矩阵、样品编号、首次试药、首次临床），每个节点标定执行单位与时间
诚实声明个人节点：在归属问题上只认领有记录可查的节点（组长职责、提取方法、以身试药报告），不认领整体发现权
为集体背书：公开声明把成果归功于协作体系与时代条件，并把个人荣誉部分回流（奖金捐设基金、提名同事）
让档案裁决：面对归属争议不诉诸立场或资格（学位、头衔、出身），而以原始记录（实验编号、报告签署、会议纪要）作为最终证据
process_en: Build the contribution map: decompose the achievement into verifiable event-nodes (the ledger, the condition matrix, sample numbers, first self-trial, first clinic), each with unit and date
Claim only one's nodes: on attribution, claim only record-backed nodes (the group-leader duty, the extraction method, the self-trial report), never the whole discovery
Underwrite the collective: publicly credit the cooperative system and its era, returning part of personal honor (prize money endowed into research funds, nominating colleagues)

Let the archives adjudicate: against attribution disputes, appeal not to standing or credentials (degrees, titles, origins) but to the primary records—experimental numbers, signed reports, meeting minutes—as final evidence
representative_cases_zh: 2015 年诺奖的'三无科学家'争议：无博士学位、无留洋、无院士头衔的获奖者引发资格之辩——屠呦呦以实验记录与报告签署回应，不与之进行身份论战
'研究成功是当年团队集体攻关的结果'的公开定调：把首功争议放回集体框架，同时拉斯克奖与诺奖的评奖档案锁定其个人节点（乙醚中性提取、191 号样品、以身试药）
奖金捐设科研基金：个人荣誉部分回流集体——归属切分在利益层面的完成
representative_cases_en: The 'three-withouts' controversy around the 2015 Nobel: a laureate with no doctorate, no study abroad, no academy membership sparked a debate over credentials—answered with experimental records and signed reports, not a war of identities

The public framing 'the success was the collective effort': the primacy dispute folded back into the collective frame, while the Lasker and Nobel citations locked her personal nodes (the neutral ether extraction, sample 191, the self-trial)
Endowing prize money into a research fund: part of personal honor returned to the collective—attribution divided also at the level of interest
modern_applications_zh: 联合研发的'贡献图谱'合同：合作项目立项时即约定贡献节点清单与证据形式（数据、代码、实验记录），专利署名与奖金分配对节点而非对职位
开源项目核心贡献者的'节点认领'：以 PR、设计文档、关键决策记录为归属证据，避免'谁在会上说了算'式的归属之争
家族企业代际交接的'责任-荣誉切分'：交接文件明确哪些节点是父辈的、哪些是继任者的——荣誉共享但节点可查
modern_applications_en: Contribution-map contracts in joint R&D: at project launch, agree on the list of contribution nodes and their evidence forms (data, code, lab records); patent listing and bonus splits keyed to nodes, not posts
Node-claiming for core contributors in open source: PRs, design documents and key decision records as attribution evidence, ending 'whoever speaks loudest in the meeting' attribution
Responsibility-honor division in family-business succession: handover documents specifying which nodes belong to the founder's generation and which to the successor—honor shared, nodes auditable
related_modes: M-TOU-001（验方集册法——归属的底册基础：可回溯的记录使贡献图谱成为可能）
M-TOU-010（一草半生收束法——归属的时间维度：五十年不换题本身就是最大的一项可核验个人贡献）
M-CC-001（孔子·君子人格选拔法——价值对照：同以'名实相符'为秩序根基，孔子以德定位，屠呦呦以记录定位）

representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—the demonstrator of attribution answered by verifiable nodes against credentialism

representative_figures.relation_zh: 跨域平行——同以可核验节点（提取与定名）在合作体系中确立个人首功，同把荣誉回流事业
representative_figures.relation_en: the cross-domain parallel—likewise secured personal primacy by verifiable nodes (isolation and naming) within a collaborative system, and returned honor to the cause

representative_figures.relation_zh: 集体图谱的另一位点——首例临床与以身试血的节点持有人，'523'贡献图谱的非中心成员
representative_figures.relation_en: another point on the collective map—holder of the first-clinic and self-inoculation nodes, a non-central member of the '523' contribution map

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/从单分子到家族的结构迭代
modes.domain_en: Methodology / structural iteration from one molecule to a family
modes.definition_zh: 药物化学方法论/发现只是第一代：以临床读数（效价、复燃率、剂型需求）驱动分子结构的逐代衍生——青蒿素→双氢青蒿素→蒿甲醚→青蒿琥酯→复方制剂——每代针对上一代的最短板（复燃率、溶解度、稳定性）定向改良，使一个发现长成药物的家族
modes.definition_en: Medicinal-chemistry methodology / discovery is only the first generation: let clinical readings (potency, recrudescence, formulation needs) drive generational structural derivation—artemisinin, dihydroartemisinin, artemether, artesunate, the combination therapies—each generation targeting the previous one's weakest link (recrudescence, solubility, stability), so one discovery grows into a family of drugs
modes.source_chapter: 双氢青蒿素的合成与 1992 年一类新药证书（抗疟效价高于青蒿素且复燃率低）；蒿甲醚（1976 年代结构改造）与复方蒿甲醚的系列档案；WHO 六种青蒿素联合疗法推荐（2010-2023 交付约 45 亿疗程）
key_concepts: 第一代只是起点 the firstborn as starting point（发现的价值在代际中兑现）
短板定向的衍生 deficiency-targeted derivation（每代只打上一代的最短板）
临床读数驱动 clinical-reading-driven（复燃率、效价、溶解度的现场数据是衍生的方向盘）
复配的代际 the combination generation（与苯芴醇、哌喹配伍对抗耐药）
适应症的代际外溢 the indication spillover（双氢青蒿素转入红斑狼疮——衍生不止于结构）
modes.key_quote_zh: 青蒿素是长子，不是独子——复燃率高就给氢，溶解度差就改醚，耐药来了就配伍；药和人一样，靠一代一代地改命。
modes.key_quote_en: Artemisinin is the firstborn, not the only child—hydrogenate against recrudescence, etherify against solubility, combine against resistance; a drug, like a person, remakes its fate generation by generation.
process_zh: 收齐第一代的短板清单：从临床试验中系统记录第一代药物的效价、复燃率、溶解度、稳定性、剂型限制——每项短板对应一个化学改造方向
单短板定向衍生：一次只针对一个短板做结构改造（还原羟基得双氢青蒿素；甲基化得蒿甲醚；琥珀酸酯化得青琥酯），读数不达标即回炉
代际验收：每个衍生物以'超越上一代的明确指标'（效价更高、复燃率更低、可注射）验收，不合格者不进入临床
走向复配与外溢：当单分子代际收益递减，转入与协同药的复方（ACT 疗法）与适应症外溢（双氢青蒿素治红斑狼疮）——家族逻辑取代单药逻辑
process_en: Collect the first generation's deficiency list: from clinical trials systematically record the first drug's potency, recrudescence, solubility, stability and formulation limits—each deficiency mapping to a chemical direction

Derive against one deficiency at a time: modify the structure against a single target (reduction gives dihydroartemisinin; methylation, artemether; succinate esterification, artesunate), remelting any that fail their readings
Accept by generation: admit a derivative to the clinic only on an explicit metric beating the previous generation (higher potency, lower recrudescence, injectability)

Turn to combination and spillover: as single-molecule returns diminish, move to combinations with partner drugs (ACT regimens) and to indication spillover (dihydroartemisinin for lupus)—the logic of family replacing the logic of a single drug
representative_cases_zh: 双氢青蒿素（1973 合成/1992 一类新药）：以'效价更高、复燃率更低'的明确代际指标验收——衍生代际法的标准示范
蒿甲醚与青蒿琥酯（1976 年代起）：分别以油溶性与水溶性为靶向的兄弟代——溶解度短板的定向修复
ACT 联合疗法与双氢青蒿素哌喹片：对抗耐药的复配代际——2010-2023 全球交付约 45 亿疗程的家族规模
representative_cases_en: Dihydroartemisinin (synthesized 1973, class-one certificate 1992): accepted on the explicit generational metric of higher potency and lower recrudescence—the standard demonstration of derivative generations
Artemether and artesunate (from the mid-1970s): sibling generations targeted at oil and water solubility respectively—the directed repair of the solubility deficiency
ACT combinations and dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine: the combination generation against resistance—some 4.5 billion courses delivered worldwide 2010-2023, the family at scale
modern_applications_zh: 软件产品的'代际演进'：v1 只负责验证核心价值，v2 针对首版最大差评点定向迭代——以'超越上代的最短板指标'作为发布验收线
组织能力的'代际复制'：单一项目成功后把其方法论衍生为培训体系、手册与复用组件——每代只修复上一代的明显缺陷
个人职业的'作品家族'：一部代表作之后不重复自己，而针对其最被诟病的短板做姊妹作——以家族逻辑经营影响力
modern_applications_en: Generational evolution in software: v1 validates the core value only; v2 iterates against the worst-reviewed point of the first—a release accepted only on beating the previous generation's weakest metric

Generational replication of organizational capability: after one project succeeds, derive its methodology into training systems, handbooks and reusable components—each generation fixing only the last's visible defects
A family of works in personal careers: after a signature piece, do not repeat yourself—make a sister work against the piece's most-criticized weakness, managing influence by family logic
related_modes: M-TOU-005（疫区闭环法——代际的信息源：临床读数是衍生的方向盘）
M-TOU-009（新适应症拓界法——家族逻辑的终点：结构代际之外还有适应症代际）
M-DAR-001（达尔文·自然选择法——机制对照：同以'变异+选择'迭代种群，达尔文交给自然，屠呦呦把选择压力握在临床读数手里）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——从青蒿素到双氢青蒿素再至复配的两代半主持者
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—overseer of two and a half generations from artemisinin through dihydroartemisinin to the combinations

representative_figures.relation_zh: 结构改造的执行代表——蒿甲醚等衍生物的合成者，代际法的化学之手
representative_figures.relation_en: the executing representative of structural modification—synthesizer of artemether and siblings, the chemical hand of the generations

representative_figures.relation_zh: 衍生逻辑的先祖——同以'魔弹'的系统结构改造遍历砷剂家族，把一个化合物变成一类药
representative_figures.relation_en: the ancestor of the derivation logic—likewise iterated the arsenical family through systematic structural modification, turning one compound into a class

modes.domain_zh: 战略学/与进化对手的长周期博弈
modes.domain_en: Strategy / the long game against an evolving opponent
modes.definition_zh: 长周期战略方法论/把'药物失效'重定义为'博弈进入新回合'：耐药不是终点而是竞争的常态形态——以机理研究（K13 突变、血红素激活、多靶点学说）定位对手的进化路径，以疗程延长与联用辅助药轮换给出不弃药位的应对方案（NEJM 2019），使一线药物的地位可持续
modes.definition_en: Long-cycle strategic methodology / redefine 'the drug failing' as 'the game entering a new round': resistance is not an end but the standing form of the contest—locate the opponent's evolutionary path by mechanism studies (K13 mutations, heme activation, the multi-target hypothesis) and answer without abandoning the drug's position (extended courses and partner-drug rotation, NEJM 2019), keeping a frontline drug's standing sustainable
modes.source_chapter: NEJM 青蒿素抗药性应对方案（2019.4.25，延长疗程至 5-7 天+更换联用辅助药物）；王继刚团队血红素激活-多靶点烷基化机理研究；WHO 青蒿素部分耐药问答（K13 标记物清单、大湄公河次区域与非洲的耐药地图）
key_concepts: 部分耐药 partial resistance（耐药的阶段性：清除延迟而非全失效——不轻言弃药）
机理定位 mechanism localization（以 K13 突变与激活机制确定对手进化的'战区'）
疗程弹性 the course lever（3 天→5 天/7 天——以剂量学而非换药应对）
辅助药轮换 partner-drug rotation（耐药常在配伍端而非主药端——轮换配伍重获疗效）
不弃药位 holding the frontline（药位是数十年积累的公共卫生资产，轻易弃位即移交战果）
modes.key_quote_zh: 耐药不是药的葬礼，是新一轮谈判的开始——先弄清对方在哪个基因上动了手脚，再决定是延长时间还是换搭档；别急着把阵地让出去。
modes.key_quote_en: Resistance is not the drug's funeral but the opening of a new round of negotiation—first learn on which gene the opponent has moved, then decide between extending the time or changing the partner; do not rush to hand over the position.
process_zh: 拒绝'失效'定谳：把疗效下降拆解为'主药失效/配伍失效/疗程不足/剂量不足'四种情形——用清除延迟与 K13 标记物定位失效层级
机理先行：在调整方案前先做机理研究（激活机制、作用靶点谱），确定对手进化的真实边界（部分耐药只影响环状体阶段）
给出最小代价应对：优先用剂量学手段（延长疗程）与配伍轮换回应，保住主药位——只在机理证明主药核心机制被突破时才考虑换代
维持监测与预案：把疗效监测写成常规制度（WHO 疗效研究），使下一轮耐药在临床显形前就被分子监测捕获
process_en: Refuse the verdict of 'failure': decompose declining efficacy into four cases—main-drug failure, partner-drug failure, insufficient course, insufficient dose—localize the level via clearance delay and K13 markers

Mechanism first: before adjusting regimens run mechanism studies (activation, target spectrum) to establish the real boundary of the opponent's evolution (partial resistance touching only the ring stage)
Answer at minimal cost: respond first with dosing levers (extended courses) and partner rotation, holding the main-drug position—consider replacement only when mechanism proves the core action broken

Institutionalize monitoring with contingencies: make efficacy monitoring routine (WHO therapeutic-efficacy studies) so the next resistance round is caught by molecular surveillance before it shows in the clinic
representative_cases_zh: NEJM 应对方案（2019）：三年攻坚后给出'延长疗程+更换辅助药'的组合拳——不弃青蒿素阵地而重获疗效的旗舰案例
大湄公河次区域的耐药地图：疗效研究与 K13 监测使耐药在治疗失败大面积发生前被定位——'监测先行'的制度化
双氢青蒿素哌喹在非洲的疗效研究：对配伍端耐药的调查区分'主药'与'搭档'的责任——应对方案从论文走进药政
representative_cases_en: The NEJM response (2019): after three years' work, the combined answer of extended courses and partner-drug exchange—the flagship case of regaining efficacy without abandoning the artemisinin position
The resistance map of the Greater Mekong Subregion: efficacy studies and K13 surveillance localizing resistance before treatment failure spread—monitoring-first institutionalized
Therapeutic-efficacy studies of dihydroartemisinin-piperaquine in Africa: attributing failure to the partner rather than the main drug—responses moving from paper into pharmacopoeia
modern_applications_zh: 安全对抗的'漏洞-补丁'长周期策略：把'系统被绕过'拆解为'凭证失效/规则失效/实现失效'，以机理定位优先于全面重构——不轻易放弃已验证的安全架构
平台对抗滥用的'策略弹性'：欺诈手法进化时先延长观察、调整风控参数与配对规则（如验证组合），而非推翻整套信任体系
企业竞争的'优势保卫战'：对手模仿导致优势稀释时，以机理定位（对手到底复制了什么）决定是加码还是换赛道——避免过度反应弃守阵地
modern_applications_en: The vulnerability-patch long game in security: decompose 'the system bypassed' into credential failure, rule failure, implementation failure; localize by mechanism before any rebuild—never lightly abandon a proven security architecture
Strategic flexibility against platform abuse: as fraud evolves, extend observation and tune risk parameters and paired rules (verification combos) before overturning the whole trust system

The defense of advantage in competition: when imitation dilutes the edge, localize by mechanism (what exactly did the rival copy) before choosing to double down or switch tracks—avoiding overreaction that surrenders the position
related_modes: M-TOU-007（衍生代际法——应变的弹药库：联用与衍生的家族逻辑是应变的物质基础）
M-TOU-009（新适应症拓界法——应变的外溢面：抗疟阵地受压时向新适应症拓展纵深）
M-NOB-005（诺贝尔·控制变量法——库内对照：同为与'失控风险'的长周期博弈，诺贝尔以一次一个未知的纪律驯化危险，屠呦呦以机理定位+最小代价应对耐药——纪律与定位的两手）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——在 77 岁后仍主持耐药应对战役的守位者
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—the position-holder commanding the resistance campaign in her late seventies

representative_figures.relation_zh: 机理定位的执行者——血红素激活-多靶点烷基化研究为应变提供进化地图
representative_figures.relation_en: the executor of mechanism localization—the heme-activation multi-target alkylation work supplying the evolutionary map for response

representative_figures.relation_zh: 对手逻辑的命名者——耐药即选择压力下的进化，应变法即把进化论写进用药策略
representative_figures.relation_en: the namer of the opponent's logic—resistance as evolution under selection pressure; the response method is evolution theory written into dosing strategy

modes.domain_zh: 方法论/老药新用的适应症开垦
modes.domain_en: Methodology / reclaiming new indications for an old drug
modes.definition_zh: 药物再定位方法论/一个分子只治一种病是临床想象的边界而非分子的边界：以'分子的作用机理在哪里还有对应病理'为指南针系统开垦新适应症——青蒿素从抗疟走向红斑狼疮（双氢青蒿素二期临床）、肿瘤与免疫领域——老药的五十年代积压数据是新大陆的海图
modes.definition_en: Drug-repositioning methodology / that one molecule treats one disease is the boundary of clinical imagination, not of the molecule: compass in hand—'where else in pathology does the mechanism have a counterpart'—systematically reclaim new indications—artemisinin from malaria to lupus (dihydroartemisinin in phase II), oncology and immunology—the decades of accumulated data on the old drug are the chart of the new continent
modes.source_chapter: 双氢青蒿素片治疗系统性红斑狼疮/盘状红斑狼疮的临床批件与 II 期试验（15 家医院入组，2016 年项目转让昆药集团）；青蒿素对盘状/系统性狼疮有效率分别超 90%/80% 的前期临床观察；蒿甲醚抗肿瘤方向的系列专利
key_concepts: 机理-病理对位 the mechanism-pathology mapping（以作用机制为筛子扫描疾病谱）
老药的海图 the old drug's chart（数十年安全性数据是新适应症的最大资产）
适应症代际 the indication generation（结构代际之外的第二增长曲线）
转让机制 the transfer mechanism（与药企签约推进临床——学术发现借产业之手走完审批）
临床想象力 the imagination of the clinic（'已知药+未知病'的组合空间）
modes.key_quote_zh: 青蒿素治疟只是它认识世界的一种方式——机理既然能激活免疫杀伤，狼疮的免疫系统就未必是禁区；老药最值钱的是它的安全档案。
modes.key_quote_en: Curing malaria is only one of artemisinin's ways of knowing the world—if the mechanism can arm immune killing, the immune system of lupus need not be forbidden ground; the most valuable asset of an old drug is its safety dossier.
process_zh: 绘制机理-病理对位图：把分子作用机理（如烷基化多靶点杀伤、免疫调节）逐条列出，扫描具有对应病理机制的疾病谱
以安全性数据定价：优先开垦'机理对位+老药安全档案深厚'的适应症——红斑狼疮作为自身免疫病与青蒿素的免疫调节读数对位
小成本临床探索：以观察性研究与前期临床（有效率 90%/80% 的读数）验证信号，而非直接跳入 III 期
借产业之手走完审批：与药企签订适应症转让合同，以商业化资源推进 II/III 期与注册——学术发现不因体制内资源有限而搁浅
process_en: Draw the mechanism-pathology map: list the molecule's mechanisms (alkylating multi-target killing, immune modulation) and scan the disease spectrum for counterpart pathology
Price by the safety dossier: reclaim first those indications where mechanism mapping meets deep safety data—lupus, an autoimmune disease, mapped against artemisinin's immune-modulation readings
Low-cost signal exploration: verify the signal with observational studies and preliminary clinics (response readings above 90% and 80%), not by leaping straight into phase III

Let industry carry the approval: sign the indication-transfer contract with a pharmaceutical firm, advancing phase II/III and registration on commercial resources—an academic discovery not stranded by limited institutional funding
representative_cases_zh: 双氢青蒿素治红斑狼疮（2016 转让昆药、II 期 15 家医院入组）：老药新用从假说到二期临床的完整闭环
盘状/系统性狼疮有效率 90%/80% 的前期读数：适应症拓界的信号采集方式——观察性数据先行、对照试验殿后
蒿甲醚抗肿瘤的 9 项专利：机理对位图在肿瘤领域的延伸开垦——适应症家族的持续外溢
representative_cases_en: Dihydroartemisinin for lupus (transfer to Kunming Pharmaceutical 2016, phase II enrollment across fifteen hospitals): the full closed loop from hypothesis to phase II of old-drug-new-use
The preliminary readings of above 90% and 80% in discoid and systemic lupus: the signal-collection style of indication frontier—observational data first, controlled trials behind
Nine patents on artemether in oncology: the mechanism map's extended reclamation in cancer—the indication family's continuing spillover
modern_applications_zh: 平台的'能力新市场'拓界：把单一场景验证过的核心能力（如风控引擎）扫描到相邻行业（金融→医疗→物流），以既有安全运行记录为最大资产
技术专利的'再定位组合'：到期或闲置专利扫描其在相邻领域的权利要求空间，以许可与转让盘活——老专利的说明书就是海图
个人技能的'跨域迁移'：把一个行业验证过的方法论（如临床试验管理）系统迁移到结构相似的领域（如大型赛事运营）——先做对位图再谈转型
modern_applications_en: Frontier markets for platform capabilities: scan a core capability proven in one scenario (a risk engine) into adjacent industries (finance, health, logistics), with the existing safety record as the greatest asset
The repositioning portfolio of patents: scan dormant or expiring patents for claim space in adjacent fields, activating by license and transfer—the old patent's specification is the chart

Cross-domain migration of personal skills: systematically carry a methodology proven in one industry (clinical-trial management) into a structurally similar one (major-event operations)—draw the mapping first, discuss the pivot after
related_modes: M-TOU-007（衍生代际法——拓界的姊妹曲线：结构代际与适应症代际共成家族逻辑）
M-TOU-008（抗药应变法——拓界的战略动因：主阵地受压时向新适应症拓展战略纵深）
M-TOU-001（验方集册法——同构的底册思维：新适应症的扫描同样始于机理-病理的对位底账）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——在八十岁后开垦狼疮新大陆的老药再定位者
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—the repositioner reclaiming the new continent of lupus in her eighties

representative_figures.relation_zh: 再定位现象的记录者——系统梳理'老药新用'（快乐粉红奥兹时代以来）的医学史家，其 Happy Accidents 一书为适应症拓界提供方法论地图
representative_figures.relation_en: the chronicler of repositioning—the historian of 'old drug, new use' since the pink-suit era, whose Happy Accidents charts the methodology of indication frontier

representative_figures.relation_zh: 适应症拓界的先例——把叶酸拮抗剂从贫血移植到白血病，开创化疗时代的'老药新用'
representative_figures.relation_en: the precedent of indication frontier—transplanting folate antagonists from anemia to leukemia, opening chemotherapy's 'old drug, new use'

modes.domain_zh: 综合方法论/单一对象的终身深耕
modes.domain_en: Synthesis / the lifelong deep cultivation of one subject
modes.definition_zh: 体系落地方法论/把毕生工作收束于一个对象（青蒿/青蒿素）：从提取、定名、结构、衍生物、耐药应对到新适应症，五十年不换题——以'一条生命线'对抗科研时尚的频繁换轨，使所有荣誉、争议与深度都积累在同一坐标系内，'呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿'成为人格与事业的同一收束
modes.definition_en: System-landing methodology / gather a life's work onto one subject (qinghao/artemisinin): extraction, naming, structure, derivatives, resistance response, new indications—fifty years without changing the subject—answering science's fashionable lane-switching with 'one lifeline,' so that honor, controversy and depth all accumulate in a single coordinate system; 'the deer call youyou, eating the hao of the field' closing person and career into one
modes.source_chapter: 1969 年入组'523'至 2019 年 NEJM 应对方案的五十年跨度；2015 卡罗琳医学院演讲《青蒿素的发现》与《诗经》命名的自述；共和国勋章（2019）授勋词；'一辈子专注青蒿素'的公开定调
key_concepts: 单对象深耕 single-subject deep cultivation（五十年的复利效应）
生命线叙事 the lifeline narrative（发现-衍生-耐药-新适应症的同轴延续）
名字的谶纬 the name as omen（'呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿'——人格与对象的名字性收束）
拒绝换轨 refusing the lane switch（在诺奖光环与多领域诱惑下守于青蒿）
收束的复利 the compound interest of closure（深度、信任与制度积累在同一坐标系内增值）
modes.key_quote_zh: 一辈子只做一件事，把青蒿素做透——名字是父亲从《诗经》里取的，事情是命运把那株蒿递到我手里；剩下的五十年，不过是把它接稳。
modes.key_quote_en: One life, one thing: make artemisinin thorough. My name my father took from the Book of Songs; my task, fate handed me the plant. The remaining fifty years were only the steadiness of the catch.
process_zh: 把对象升格为纲领：在第一个成功（青蒿素）之后不宣告完工，而把对象写成一条纲领——'把这个药做透'涵盖提取、衍生、机理、耐药与新病
拒绝高价值换轨：在诺奖光环与多方向诱惑下守住单对象——新增课题只有作为青蒿素生命线的延伸才立项
以时间积累复利：五十年的同一坐标系使每一项新工作（安全档案、临床网络、政策信任）都在旧的积累上增值
以名字完成收束：人格、对象与叙事收束于同一符号（呦呦/青蒿/《诗经》）——外部叙事（诺奖、勋章）与内部叙事（一生一事）在同一坐标汇流
process_en: Raise the object into a program: after the first success, do not declare completion—write the subject into a program, 'make this drug thorough,' spanning extraction, derivatives, mechanism, resistance and new diseases
Refuse high-value lane switches: under Nobel luster and multi-direction temptation hold the single subject—a new topic is chartered only as an extension of the artemisinin lifeline
Let time compound: fifty years in one coordinate system let every new work (the safety dossier, the clinical network, policy trust) accrue on old accumulation

Close with the name: person, object and narrative converge in one sign (Youyou/qinghao/the Book of Songs)—the outer narrative (Nobel, medal) and the inner (one life, one thing) meeting in a single coordinate
representative_cases_zh: 1969-2019 的五十年跨度：从受命组长到 NEJM 应对方案，同一对象的完整生命线——'一辈子专注青蒿素'的公开定调
诺奖后的守题：2015 年后未转向多领域蹭热度，而是把奖项转化为青蒿素研究中心的抗药性与新适应症议程
'呦呦鹿鸣，食野之蒿'的人格收束：名字、植物与事业在同一符号内互证——人格收束的中文范本
representative_cases_en: The fifty-year span 1969-2019: from appointed group leader to the NEJM response, one subject's complete lifeline—the public framing 'a lifetime devoted to qinghao'
Holding the subject after the Nobel: no pivot to fashionable fields after 2015; the prize converted into the Artemisinin Research Center's agenda of resistance and new indications
The persona closed in 'the deer call youyou, eating the hao': name, plant and career mutually attested within one sign—the Chinese template of personal closure
modern_applications_zh: 个人职业的'单一生命线'策略：不追逐赛道轮动，把全部作品收束于一个可积累的坐标（一门手艺、一个领域），以二十年尺度评估复利
组织的'纲领式立项'：新课题只有作为核心纲领（如'把某产品做透'）的延伸才立项——防止资源在多方向上摊薄
知识产品的'坐标收束'：研究者或创作者的全部产出统一在同一问题坐标下，使引用、声誉与深度在同一坐标系内累积
modern_applications_en: The single-lifeline strategy for careers: chase no lane rotation; gather all works into one accumulable coordinate (a craft, a field), compounding assessed on a twenty-year scale
Program-based chartering in organizations: charter a new topic only as an extension of the core program ('make this product thorough')—keeping resources from thinning across directions
Coordinate closure for knowledge products: unify a researcher's or creator's whole output under one question-coordinate, so citations, reputation and depth compound in the same system
related_modes: M-TOU-006（协作归属法——收束的诚实面：终身深耕不吞并集体贡献，个人坐标与集体图谱并行）
M-TOU-009（新适应症拓界法——收束不是封闭：单对象内的持续开垦）
M-SPI-010（斯宾诺莎·体系人格收束法——结构平行：同以一生收束于一个体系/对象，斯宾诺莎以生活兑现体系，屠呦呦以岁月兑现一株草）

representative_figures.relation_zh: 本模式的原型——五十年不换题、以一株草收束一生的当事人
representative_figures.relation_en: the prototype—fifty years on one subject, a life closed by one plant

representative_figures.relation_zh: 收束的结构平行——同以毕生收束于一个体系，人格与作品互证
representative_figures.relation_en: the structural parallel of closure—likewise gathered a life into one system, person and work attesting each other

representative_figures.relation_zh: 单对象深耕的平行者——同以数十年守于一个对象（藤壶/物种起源），以时间换深度
representative_figures.relation_en: the parallel of single-subject cultivation—decades on one object (barnacles, the origin of species), trading time for depth
